decision_rule: Descriptive P12 C1 np1/2/4 only: COMPLETE requires all three exact cells, harness rc0, actual performed successful drop_caches with cold_cache_guaranteed=true, in-window placement PASS, and /slots busy GET fully overlapping successful same-cell same-port request on every expected port. Missing occupancy is incomplete evidence, not absence. Native smoke does not satisfy full-run completion. Expected: existing C1 ~84–90 aggregate tok/s; single replicate is descriptive, not a formal speed claim. Stop-on-answer when all three native cells satisfy the specified overlap, placement and cache witnesses; stop-on-futility on STOP, deadline, server failure or missing required proof; no interim decision-grade gate.
